outcome: Success of medical management for RPOC
cohort: 41 postpartum patients presenting with secondary PPH and evidence of RPOC on ultrasound
finding: For patients presenting with secondary PPH and sonographic RPOC, medical management was successful in only 29% of cases, and increased endometrial thickness was associated with an increased requirement for surgical management.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant association between the mode of delivery and the success of medical management for retained products of conception.
